components.gap: The full proof promised by proved=annex:p15.polya-posterior-prediction is not completely written. Annex lines 175-182 assert that a single future indicator has conditional mean a/T and variance ab/T^2 and that two distinct future indicators have conditional joint success probability a(a+1)/(T(T+1)), and then add these over all m positions and all m(m-1) ordered pairs to get E(K_{n,m}|F_n)=ma/T and Var(K_{n,m}|F_n)=mab(T+m)/(T^2(T+1)). The written argument (lines 167-173) gives only the conditional probability of a specified future word of length m. It never derives the conditional marginal of B_{n+j} for j>=2, or of a non-adjacent future pair. No conditional exchangeability of the future block given the past word is shown, no marginalization over intermediate draws is written, no martingale step is given, and the proof makes no appeal to the conditional Bernoulli product of thm:p15-polya-beta-limit. So the stated conditional mean and variance of K_{n,m}, and the m>1 comparison with mX_n(1-X_n) that depends on that variance, rest on a step that is asserted but not proved.

So the source's displayed variant is not preserved. The annex proof (lines 315-323) extends the construction without saying so.

The per-indicator conditional mean and variance, and the pairwise joint success probability, are asserted for arbitrary future positions without being derived from the future-word formula at lines 167-171. A one-line step is missing: either conditional exchangeability (the future-word probabilities depend only on the count) or marginalization through the conditional Bernoulli product of thm:p15-polya-beta-limit.
